name: Somchai Dejdamrong
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly while restoring vintage cars in his small Bangkok workshop. His meticulous eye for detail and passion for flawless finishes caught the attention of a local racing team, who recruited him to handle their paintwork. He quickly adapted to the fast-paced environment, mastering the intricacies of applying durable, lightweight coatings that meet the demands of competitive racing. 

Somchai is driven by a desire to perfect his craft. He's constantly researching new techniques and materials to enhance the performance and aesthetics of his work. While his management skills are still developing, his ambition and dedication to quality make him a valuable asset to any team. He sees the paint job as more than just aesthetics, understanding its role in aerodynamics and overall performance.

physical.description: A sturdy man with kind eyes and calloused hands that betray his meticulous work.

quirks: Always brings a small Buddha amulet to the paint booth for good luck.
Insists on using traditional Thai music while working to maintain focus.
Meticulously cleans his spray guns after every use, even during crunch time.
